page.overview:
Who is Duelstronauts?

The Duelstronauts, known as the Space Operations Duel Squadron (宇宙作戦デュエル隊 Uchū Sakusen Dyueru-tai) in the Japanese version, is an organization within Goha #5 Elementary in the Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS anime, led by Booster Page. Their goal is to explore space through Dueling.
